svg.data-coverage: One FHM supports up to 8 RUs; cascading can be used to extend coverage
svg.data-reach-qsfp28: 10 km max at 40/100G (HIG port overview, ports 12-13)
svg.data-operating-temp: -40 to 70 C (datasheet; HIG checklist says -40 to 65 C - see gaps)
svg.data-fpga: Intel Stratix 10 TX (O-RAN shared cell function)
svg.data-fronthaul: various fiber length delay compensation; configurable data compression mode, IQ data width and U/C plane VLAN ID
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 T-TC (G.8275.1; T-BC, T-GM and G.8264 ESMC available with future premium versions), Class C
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in, 1PPS SMB in/out, 10MHz SMB in/out, BITS RJ48 in/out, ToD RJ45 in/out
svg.data-gnss: GPS L1C/A, GLONASS L1OF, BeiDou B1, Galileo E1B/C; passive or active antenna auto-detected (active supply 5 V DC / 150 mA, min RF sensitivity -166 dBm); activated with a software license key on future premium versions
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER (datasheet supported accessories)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: none published - the QSFP28 ports are reserved and the datasheet's supported-accessories list carries only 10G SFP+ optics
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; EN 303 413; EN 301 489; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A; KS C 9832 Class A; KS C 9835

The manifest carries the datasheet figure because the datasheet is authoritative for the box's own power figure; the HIG number may be a provisioning ceiling tied to the 200 W PSU rating, but the HIG states it as consumption, so that reading cannot be assumed.","reason":"sources-disagree","scope":["power-max-w"],"wanted":"a nameplate photo, or a UfiSpace clarification of which figure is the draw","what":"system-power-figure"},{"note":"The datasheet's accessory list rates the orderable PSUs at 200 W ('PSU-201-DISB, 200W DC PSU' / 'PSU-201-AISB, 200W AC PSU') and the HIG recommends 'a reserve of at least 200 watts on each power circuit'; the HIG's Figure 5 callout instead prints '2 x 120W AC or DC PSU'. Which pair belongs to which port is not documented anywhere in the intake; the assignment here (left to port 12, right to port 13) is symmetry, not a source.","reason":"vendor-silent","scope":["led-port-12-a","led-port-12-b","led-port-13-a","led-port-13-b","led-port-12-c","led-port-12-d","led-port-13-c","led-port-13-d"],"wanted":"a vendor faceplate legend or a lit-unit photograph","what":"qsfp28-led-ownership"},{"note":"HIG section 8 says 'there are two locations on the case in which the grounding lug may be fixed' and Figure 22 shows one, on the right flank behind the front face. The second is shown in no figure and no photo in the intake reaches it. Five media, one job, exactly the cluster the s9510-28dc carries","role":"management","term":"Port"}},"kind":"device","manufacturer":"UfiSpace","maturity":"modelled","model":"M3000-14XC","name":"m3000-14xc","portfolio":{"family":"Fronthaul Multiplexer","line":"Telecoms","series":"Fronthaul Series"},"profile":"networking","provenance":{"attrs":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet (Specifications / Performance / Regulatory Compliance / Supported Accessories sections) and HIG (port overview table for reach, section 11 for the console settings, Installing an Antenna for GNSS constellations and active-antenna limits). Port roles: '8 x 10G SFP+ ports to O-RU', '4 x 10G SFP+ ports to O-DU; only port 8 is available for now, ports 9-11 are reserved', '2 x 100G QSFP28 (Reserved)'. Compliance transcribed verbatim, not tidied."},"bits-tod-stack-jacks":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - BITS/TOD are one silver ganged shell x 156.9-174.2, y 9.4-36.4 with two 8P8C jacks on a ~13.8 mm vertical pitch; the OOB/STACK pair is a second shell x 207.5-224.8, y 9.8-35.2 on a 13.2 mm pitch. Both pitches are under the 16 mm std/rj45 bezel, so all four jacks are std/rj45-ganged (12.7 x 11) with the shells drawn as panel decor per the s9510-28dc precedent. ORIENTATION READ AT 6x ZOOM: in each stacked pair the TOP jack is keyway-up (rotate: 180) and the BOTTOM jack keyway-down - the rows mirror, as ganged stacks do. The management jacks carry corner lamps (top pair at y 9.9 unlit, bottom pair photo-detected at (210.1, 33.7) and (221.9, 33.7) lit green); semantics from the HIG Management port LED table."},"bottom":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"estimated - no source shows the underside; the compliance sticker placement is the house convention (every shipped unit carries one), position estimated. A bottom view mirrors left and right; the sticker is the only content, so the axis does not bite."},"chassis":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet - '1 RU, 440 x 250 x 43.5 mm', 'Net weight: 4.18 kg', repeated by the HIG's Component Physical Information table ('M3000-14XC (W x D x H) 440 x 250 x 43.5mm', 'Chassis without FRU 4.18kg'). The 440 mm is the BODY, not a rack face: the HIG's Space Clearance section says 'width is 17.32 inches (44cm) and shipped with rack mount brackets suitable for 19 inch racks' - the bolt-on brackets (50.4 x 43 x 20 mm each, accessory item 3) make up the difference and are not drawn. Depth 250 is 'without the field replaceable units'; the PSU handles stand 10 mm proud (HIG Fig 6, 221 vs 211 mm)."},"console-usb":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - one silver bezel x 181.2-199.6, y 12.0-35.2 holding the RJ45 console (keyway-up, rotate: 180; labelled IOIOI above) over a USB-A socket (labelled with the USB trident below, drawn as a path mark). The HIG calls the RJ45 'the RJ45 port labelled IOIO' and the USB 'a maintenance port', USB 2.0 by the accessory cable. THE TONGUE FOLLOWS THAT READING AND IT IS THE WEAKEST ONE HELD: the placement asks std/usb-a@1 for its `usb2` skin, so the drawing no longer paints the USB-3 blue, but the version behind it is inferred from a shipped cable rather than stated of the port. A line in the HIG naming the port's version would settle it either way."},"environment":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet - operating -40 to 70 C, storage -40 to 70 C, operating humidity 5-95% RH, storage 5-93% RH (the datasheet's OCR splits the digits; the ranges reassemble unambiguously). THE HIG's preparation checklist instead says 'working temperature is -40 to 65 C' - recorded as a sources-disagree gap, datasheet carried."},"front-photo-scale":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - the front photo is 6717 x 669 px for a 440 x 43.5 mm face: aspect 10.04 against a true 10.11 (0.8% out), so it passes the aspect gate and positions were taken from it at 15.27 px/mm. All front placement coordinates below are photo-measured at that scale unless marked otherwise. The rear photo (6715 x 669, aspect 10.04) was used the same way. The HIG's Figure 5/9 faceplate figures agree on arrangement and supplied the callout names."},"ground-mark":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - earth symbol in a circle printed at (430.1, 21.6) at the far right of the faceplate. No connector: the bonding points are on the right flank (HIG section 8); this mark is taken as pointing at them."},"left":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"estimated - the left flank appears in the angle photo as plain metal with perimeter screws; three screw heads drawn at estimated positions. AXIS: x = 0 is the REAR on a left view (viewer3d.js convention). Content is honestly sparse rather than blank."},"lifecycle":{"note":"searched 2026-08-28, 'UfiSpace M3000-14XC end of life' - no announcement found; the product page is live and the unit is actively marketed. none-announced is a real finding, not an omission."},"part-numbers":{"note":"none stated - neither the datasheet nor the HIG prints an orderable chassis SKU (the accessory list names only the PSUs, PSU-201-DISB/PSU-201-AISB). No SKU is invented; the configurations carry none."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet - 'Max power: 103.9 Watts', with no configuration or ambient stated, so power-envelope is unstated. THE HIG DISAGREES: its Connecting Power section (both DC and AC) says 'The maximum system power consumption is 197 watts' - same measure, same scope, different value; recorded as a sources-disagree gap and the datasheet figure carried per the source-role table. PSU inputs from the datasheet (AC 100-240 V 3 A, DC -36 to -75 V 8 A); per-PSU rating on the ufispace/psu-201-* contracts."},"psu-bays":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured positions (psu-0 face at x 6.4, psu-1 at 64.2, both y 1.6); bay size 50.5 x 40.2 from the HIG Component Physical Information table and Fig 6 drawing. Between them a black divider strip printed PSU0 / PSU1 vertically with a pair of pointer triangles - the strip is decor, the legends silkscreen. Vendor spells the bays PSU0 and PSU1, so the psus group is index-origin 0."},"qsfp28":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - one stacked pair x 400.9-421.0 (common/qsfp-cage@2 19.5 wide + shell), port 12 top (y 9.4, rotate: 180, mirrored about the band like the s9510 pair), port 13 bottom (y 25.5). Central silver band y 19.7-25.5 carries, left to right, two small up triangles, two dark round holes, two more up triangles (lamp centres ~403.4/406.0 and 416.0/418.1, y 22.6); the holes are drawn as dark decor dots. Green '12'/'13' label pads above and below (decor, numerals silkscreen). Below the block two small dark pads (y 38.0) each hold two more unlit triangles - drawn as lamps assigned left pad to port 12, right pad to port 13 BY SYMMETRY ONLY; see the qsfp28-led-ownership gap."},"rear":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - four circular hex fan grilles, centres x 44.5/94.5/144.5/194.5 on an exactly 50.0 mm pitch (edge pairs colour-thresholded from the rear photo), ~36 mm diameter, drawn as rx-18 vent-pattern decor. THE FANS ARE FIXED, NOT FRUs - '4 Fixed Fans' (datasheet and HIG Fig 8) - so there are no fan bays and no fan module components; the FAN lamp's for: is the chassis. Right-hand hex vent field x 320-423, y 3.5-25. Five case screws photo-measured (the centre one at (214, 34) is a larger cross-recess feature, drawn with the same screw-head part). No rear silkscreen is printed."},"right":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"drawing-fraction estimates - HIG Fig 22 shows this flank (the timing jacks appear at its left edge, so the front is at the figure's left): two hex vent fields at roughly 0.29-0.44 and 0.67-0.84 of the depth from the front, and the designated grounding location (two tapped holes for the accessory lug, M4 screws) ~37-82 mm behind the front face, drawn as two common/ground-lug holes at x 45/58. The figure's aspect was not verifiable against 250 x 43.5, so all x positions are fractions, not measurements. AXIS: x = 0 is the FRONT on a right view (viewer3d.js convention)."},"sfp-2x2":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - ports 8-11 are a 2x2 ganged block, columns at x 364.0 and 378.25 (numeral centres 371.1 and 385.4 on the blue bands above and below), top row y 8.8, bottom row y 24.5 and MIRRORED (rotate: 180 - bails face the central silver band, checked at 4x zoom). The band (y 19.2-24.4) carries an up/down lamp pair per column: up = top port, down = bottom port, photo-detected at x 369.5/373.3/383.8/387.6, y centre 22.8. Numbering runs down columns (8 over 9, 10 over 11), the vendor's own print. Blue bands are faceplate paint, drawn as decor so the numerals stay readable."},"sfp-row":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - eight cages in two ganged blocks of four; the per-port lamps above them were colour-detected at x 240.09, 254.32, 268.57, 282.80 / 305.84, 320.08, 334.30, 348.56 (y 21.7): pitch 14.24 mm within a block, which is the std/sfp-ganged 14.25 contract to 0.1%, so cages sit at lamp-centre minus 7.125. Block gap 8.7 mm. Cage tops at y 24.6 (aperture 24.8-35.0 in the photo). Port numbers 0-7 printed dark on an olive-yellow band (decor) under each block, numeral centred per cage."},"sources":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet (m3000-14xc-datasheet.pdf, converted) and Hardware Installation Guide (m3000-14xc-hig.pdf, converted, Figures 1-35), plus three vendor renders/photos: m3000-14xc-2-front.jpg (6717x669 straight-on front), m3000-14xc-3-rear.jpg (6715x669 straight-on rear), m3000-14xc-1-angle.png (three-quarter view). No mechanical drawing of the chassis exists in the intake; the PSU has one (HIG Fig 6)."},"status-leds":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - six lamps in one column at x 144.9-147.5, centres y 19.3 to 31.8 on a 2.5 mm pitch, labels printed dark on a white strip to their right (decor at x 148.3). Top-to-bottom order GNSS SYNC SYS FAN PWR ID as printed. State vocabularies transcribed from HIG section 10 Front Panel LED tables; the ID lamp's blue beacon row included. common/led-rect is 4.6 mm wide against ~2.6 in the photo and its skin draws a bezel slightly past its contract, so the column is drawn at x 143.6 (0.8 left of measured) and the labels at 149.8 to keep both clear of the bezel; pitch drawn at 2.7 rather than the measured 2.5 because the contract's 2.6 mm lamp cannot sit on a 2.5 pitch without overlapping (L13)."},"timing-block":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - 1PPS SMB centre (127.4, 9.1), 10MHZ SMB centre (127.5, 20.8), GNSS ANT SMA centre (127.8, 31.9), each labelled above its jack; M3000-14XC wordmark baseline at y 39.8 starting x 119.7. Jack outline sizes are the common/sma-jack and common/smb-jack components' own (registry-derived), not re-measured."},"top":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"estimated - no drawing dimensions the lid. Three shallow oval recesses per row, two rows, positions taken as fractions of the HIG Fig 5 top view (aspect not verified against 440 x 250, so treated as schematic): rows at y 64 and 182, ovals starting x 14.8/74.2/125. AXIS: y = 0 is the REAR, per the house top-view convention; the Fig 5 top view prints the front (PSU edge) at the bottom. Four perimeter screws estimated from the angle photo. Content is deliberately sparse - the lid is plain metal."},"vent-islands":{"note":"derived - a vent field is a perforation and the drawing said so, but the marks printed inside one were floating on air (L64). The vendor interrupts the perforation where it prints, so each of those marks now has a solid patch under it in the chassis colour, drawn over the vent the way ufispace/s9600-72xc paints its port bands over one. The patch is the printing's own footprint plus 0.4 mm, which is what the S9610-36D's front render measures: its slots stop 0.4 mm outside each lamp cluster and resume 0.4 mm past it. Where a vent is simply measured wider than the metal it reaches, this states the metal that the printing proves is there without re-measuring the field."},"vents-front":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - hex vent field x 228.5-357.0, y 3.6-17.8, its left edge actually a hex-follow staircase drawn here as a straight edge; above it and running on to x 420 a 2.4 mm strip of short dark slots (y 1.0-3.4) modelled with the slots-h pattern, pattern-offset chosen so a slot row lands inside the strip."}},"references":[{"sha256":"d22b6e050e55abf9815c1b41e0213928437ff7c4e55c36da6da45305d0094775","title":"UfiSpace M3000-14XC Hardware Installation Guide"}],"version":"2.0.10","views":{"bottom":{"components":{"placements":[{"at":[110.5,22],"group":"furniture","id":"bottom-label","ref":"common/compliance-sticker@1","rel-pos":10}]},"size":{"h":250,"w":440}},"front":{"components":{"bays":[{"accepts":["ufispace/psu-201-dc@1","ufispace/psu-201-ac@1"],"at":[6.4,1.6],"default":"ufispace/psu-201-dc@1","group":"psus","id":"psu-0","rel-pos":0,"size":{"h":40.2,"w":50.5}},{"accepts":["ufispace/psu-201-dc@1","ufispace/psu-201-ac@1"],"at":[64.2,1.6],"default":"ufispace/psu-201-dc@1","group":"psus","id":"psu-1","rel-pos":1,"size":{"h":40.2,"w":50.5}}],"placements":[{"at":[123.9,5.6],"attrs":{"role":"1pps-io"},"group":"timing","id":"clk-1pps","ref":"common/smb-jack@1","rel-pos":1},{"at":[124.0,17.3],"attrs":{"role":"10mhz-io"},"group":"timing","id":"clk-10mhz","ref":"common/smb-jack@1","rel-pos":2},{"at":[123.05,27.15],"attrs":{"role":"gnss-in"},"group":"timing","id":"gnss-ant","ref":"common/sma-jack@1","rel-pos":3},{"at":[143.6,17.8],"description":"HIG GNSS row - Off (not configured), Solid Green (normal state, self-survey complete), Blinking Green (learning state, self-survey not completed), Solid Yellow (power up, not tracking any satellite), Blinking Yellow (antenna short to ground).
